headline: Never forget when Lil Uzi Vert tried to jump across NAV’s pool and completely wiped out Th
body: Never forget when Lil Uzi Vert tried to jump across NAV’s pool and completely wiped out The funniest part was NAV’s reaction. He was standing nearby and immediately started laughing as Uzi climbed back out. Uzi somehow laughed it off and kept it moving like nothing happened. NAV later explained that Uzi had made the same jump years earlier when the water level was lower, which makes the whole thing even funnier. liluzivert nav hiphop funny.

Never forget when Lil Uzi Vert tried to jump across NAV’s pool and completely wiped out 😭 

The funniest part was NAV’s reaction. He was standing nearby and immediately started laughing as Uzi climbed back out.

Uzi somehow laughed it off and kept it moving like nothing happened. NAV later explained that Uzi had made the same jump years earlier when the water level was lower, which makes the whole thing even funnier.
